description: Status authority for eight problems of squares in an equilateral triangle (N = 4, M = 3). The build keeps the value of the record already held, checks that it agrees with the proven side, and sets the status, citation and note. Hosono's repository lists n = 5 as not done, so it is not here; see not_proven.

not_proven.why: Hosono's repository lists n = 5 as not done (release triangle-v1). Friedman's page also says he proved n = 2 to 7, which would make n = 5 proven_unrefereed under the 2023 rule; it stays best_known.

records.source_name: Hiroaki Hosono, square-packing: squares in an equilateral triangle
records.citation: s = 3/2 + √3. Proved by Hiroaki Hosono in October 2026 (computer-assisted).
records.note: Proved side 3/2 + √3, by the computer-assisted proof of Hiroaki Hosono, square-packing, https://github.com/wand125/square-packing/tree/triangle-v1/problems/triangle (release triangle-v1, MIT licence, October 2026, accessed 2026-10-29). The lower and upper bound certificates are checked by two independent exact checkers. The lower bound is also checked in Lean 4. The repository's README says none of this is peer reviewed.
